answer: Require every agent identity to carry a public, append-only thread of its past work, each entry countersigned by the peers it served. New identities start with no reputation and earn nectar - payment and trust - only gradually, as their thread accumulates verified completions. A Sybil attacker must therefore grow each fake identity the slow way, like seasoning timber: forging one cheap identity is easy, but forging a hundred mature, attested threads costs more in time and compute than the rewards they could extract.
